statusNote: The 2026 All-Star season is complete. Dates and sign-ups for next season will be posted here in the spring.
highlight: Our Mustang and Bronco baseball teams made deep runs in the 2025 PONY tournaments. The Bronco team reached the Bronco Zone tournament, the PONY World Series qualifier, facing teams from several states.

sports.name: Baseball
sports.summary: Local invitational tournaments in late May and June, then the PONY tournaments in July. Teams that keep winning advance to Super-Regional, Zone and the PONY World Series, which can run into August.
sports.availability: Available for most of the summer, and all of the July PONY tournaments
sports.teamTargets: 1 Pinto team, 1–2 Mustang teams and 1–2 Bronco teams

sports.name: Softball
sports.summary: Invitational tournaments from late May into June, including tournaments PG PONY hosts. The season ends with the invitationals; softball doesn't play the July–August PONY tournaments.
sports.availability: Available from late May through June

timeline.title: Player and coach interest due
timeline.desc: Register your player's interest on SportsConnect and list any conflicts in May, June and July. Coaches submit the coaching interest form.

timeline.title: Teams selected
timeline.desc: Current division head coaches and the division's All-Star head coach pick the rosters.

timeline.title: Practices start
timeline.desc: 2–3 practices a week, overlapping with the end of the spring season.

timeline.title: Invitational tournaments
timeline.desc: Local invitationals around the Monterey Peninsula, some hosted by PG PONY — typically Memorial Day weekend, the first weekend in June and Father's Day weekend. Softball's All-Star season ends here.

timeline.title: PONY tournaments
timeline.desc: Regional, then Super-Regional, Zone and the PONY World Series for teams that keep advancing.
